discriminant.question: Does a residue16 hydroxyl explain the moderate residual turnover of Tyr16Ser?

donor_control.scope: Named pKSI single-mutant panel on5(10)-EST; side-chain hydroxyl presence alone is insufficient to explain the pattern. Not general proof that hydroxyl groups never help catalysis.

source_model.description: Small substitutions may permit cavity water to replace donor solvation, whereas Phe may introduce a hydrophobic desolvating environment beyond loss of the Tyr16 hydrogen bond.

discriminant.prevented_transfer: A single donor-deletion factor is contradicted across these named sidechains in the5(10)-EST panel; neither it nor an isolated-energy interpretation is qualified for transfer to other substrates, analogue states or catalytic backgrounds.
discriminant.source_locator: Results Rate Effects and Figs2-4; Conclusions/Fig5

limitations: Source-named pKSI constructs. Main Methods reports DNA-sequence confirmation of plasmids encoding Tyr16 mutants; it does not explicitly establish WT or D40N-background sequencing or full-gene/specimen sequences. Single-mutant turnover and double-mutant analogue measurements are distinct constructs and physical preparations are not equated.

5(10)-EST turnover is distinct from 5-AND kinetics in the1995/2014 packets, equilenin crystallography, fluoronitrophenolate NMR and19-nortestosterone-sulfate IR. No conditions, numerical effects or specimen identity transfer across these contexts.
The direct donor-control inference concerns moderate residual turnover in this named panel. Similar rounded kcat effects do not establish identical microscopic mechanisms or statistical equivalence.

Aqueous-like Ser cavity and hydrophobic/desolvating Phe are the authors' model. Water density is observed only in the analogue-bound Y16S/D40N crystal; hydration of Thr/Ala/Gly is expected by the source, not observed here.

Phe productive equilenin geometry is a superposition of unliganded Y16F1EA2 and WT-bound1OH0. The cited Y16F/D40N1OHO structure has backward analogue binding. Absence of modeled water is not proof of absent solution water; no direct single-mutant reacting-state coordinates are supplied.

The supporting17.4ppm1H resonance is measured in C.testosteroni Y16F/D40N with equilenin, not the P.putida single-mutant turnover construct. It is not projected as direct evidence of that construct's Asp103 contact.

The source calls the200-fold hydrogen-bond contribution estimate crude and conditional on cavity solvation resembling bulk water and no propagated rearrangement. This packet does not adopt an isolated hydrogen-bond energy or universal design threshold.

Main-body factors and numerical uncertainty scope are incomplete without SI. No absolute rates, full assay reconstruction, new experiment, independent human review, complete mechanism, protected registry admission or validated enzyme design follows.
